description: Drive-canon geography synchronization overlay for Wire to Wire. Derivative site/app integration metadata only; the existing Google Drive v3.3 master remains authoritative for every Horse_ID, Person_ID, Organization_ID and Track_ID. Supersedes older staging counts without changing historical source facts.

authority.source: WTW CANON REGISTRIES — 1999 START v3.3 WORKING RECONCILIATION

boundary_cases.name: Delaware Park
boundary_cases.note: Official address is Wilmington; access/location commonly described at Stanton. Use Wilmington node until parcel boundary is finalized.

boundary_cases.name: Golden Gate Fields
boundary_cases.note: Property spans Albany and Berkeley; majority is in Albany. Use Albany as travel node pending parcel-level rule.

boundary_cases.name: Suffolk Downs
boundary_cases.note: Historic property spans East Boston and Revere. Clubhouse/track access anchor is East Boston; preserve both municipalities.

boundary_cases.name: Great Lakes Downs
boundary_cases.note: Racing authority used a Muskegon postal address; parcel evidence places site in Fruitport Township. Use Muskegon travel node pending normalization.

boundary_cases.name: Bainbridge Park
boundary_cases.note: Sources place track along Route 43 in Aurora and identify Bainbridge Township. Use Aurora travel node.

calendar_join_audit.policy: Do not invent track entities or promote quarantine editions simply to fill missing track IDs.

shipping_geography.method: Coarse planning bands derived from canonical city/locality travel nodes. Bands are intentionally conservative and are not surveyed road mileages. Current event windows are tested for horse-van feasibility, chronology, and absence of teleportation.

organization_geography.note: Existing historical lower-precision rows retained for provenance. Locked exact opening travel nodes are distinct from legal street addresses.

trainer_participant_geography.note: Dated historical seasonal base changes remain unresolved; do not infer race-day jockey/trainer from season records.

horse_current_geography.note: Jan. 1 1999 survival/boarding of the 2036 production dams is deliberate WTW canon, not independently recovered historical fact; no current pregnancy, breeding health, ownership or future record is imputed. What Next H-1993-000007 added as 31st stud-resident stallion at existing Little Fork Farm, canon assumption.

horse_foaling_geography_b01.note: Approved WTW localities; no inference that foaling locality equals current barn.

jockey_bases.note: Exact city/home track and birthplace remain pending unless separately sourced.

horse_foaling_geography_all.note: Foaling geography is distinct from Jan 1 1999 physical residence; inferred localities are labeled deliberate fictional WTW canon, never historical source claims.

calendar_policy.pre_1973: Year-level historical race timing is sufficient unless exact-day evidence is needed to resolve a specific chronology/travel contradiction.
calendar_policy.from_1973_forward: Historically sourced exact race date is required wherever available; 1999-pattern reconstructed dates are not certification evidence.
calendar_policy.travel_rule: Use sourced post-1973 exact dates plus canonical geography nodes to reject impossible campaign sequences.
